rows.definition: The multi-wave debt-retirement CAMPAIGN plan `debtlane.WavePlan` (internal/debtlane/wave.go), produced by `PlanWaves`: it partitions debt lanes into ordered, collision-free, concurrent-safe waves and reports total waves, planned lanes and projected grade.
rows.distinction: The whole CAMPAIGN plan for retiring debt in waves - NOT the per-issue execution plan `dispatchWaveExecutionPlan` (one wave's ready rows) and NOT the umbrella `plan` domain.
